twin.title: Two simulated years of alloy discovery, from the day the money arrives: round 5 (preview)

parts.caption: powder-doser's chain carousel v5 · A&D HR-202i balance · Specac Atlas Autotouch 15T vacuum press
parts.what: A 5N Al cup from the rack to the doser's shuttle; module 6 docks, tilts and doses Si onto the balance.

parts.caption: AMAZEMET rePowder ultrasonic atomizer, cut open for the pour
parts.what: Both arms on the plate's landing stage; the melt pours onto the vibrating plate and atomizes.

parts.caption: Retsch AS 200 sieve shaker, in a downdraft enclosure
parts.what: The stack sieves under its clamped lid, drawn see-through; each fraction tinted under a legend.

parts.caption: Rigaku MiniFlex benchtop powder XRD, its housing drawn see-through
parts.what: The holder in, the door shut; the scan; the pattern (computed, not measured).

parts.caption: Instron 68FM-100 · 3119-608 environmental chamber · AVE 2 video extensometer
parts.what: A bar in the grips, the chamber cut away, the pull (curve illustrative), broken.

parts.caption: LECO PX500 grinder-polisher and its magazine of pre-loaded discs
parts.what: The arm puts the 320-grit disc on the magnetic platen; the pistons press the mounts down.

parts.caption: Hitachi TM4000PlusII tabletop SEM · Oxford Instruments AZtecOne EDS
parts.what: The conductive mount into the SEM's grounded holder cup; pump-down; a BSE image (illustrative).

parts.caption: AMAZEMET rePowder, 27 Oct 2026: 630 bronze molten, then atomizing on the plate (youtu.be/2brsz-90seg) · with 28 Oct's run, 1,015 g sieved under 250 µm from 1,938 g charged (DAL PR 286)
parts.what: The lab's own run k7m2q9: the melt through the furnace port, the jet atomizing through the view port, and its sieved powder.

parts.caption: The arm swaps rePowder's ultrasonic plate: the old one off its M8 stud to its labelled slot, a W-coated plate on
parts.what: One of eight atomizer turnaround clips: the old plate slid off its stud, the new one slid on.

parts.caption: Stäubli CombiTac dock: power, Ethernet, air, N2 and chilled water mate in a set order; each powered tray has a UPS
parts.what: The dock's head comes in; the last 15 mm of the electrical frame at Staubli's mating speed.

parts.caption: Amerex B570 Class D extinguishers, 30 lb of Super D: on every MiR250 in an 811 bracket, and at each powder station
parts.what: The B570 strapped into its 811 bracket on the MiR250's cabinet, ready for anyone near the robot.

parts.caption: Unit 3 squeegees the floor on a Nilfisk CFM 118EXP explosion-proof vacuum's hose, then its camera checks the colour
parts.what: Two lanes of the squeegee along the atomizer's front, then the colour check (NFPA 484).

parts.caption: A person changes the 118EXP's liner: sealed in place, lifted out to the Al-family pail. Powder waste never rides a MiR250
parts.what: Vacuum unplugged, head off, the liner sealed in place and carried to its family's pail.

parts.caption: EOS M 400-4: four lasers on one 400 x 400 mm build, two Sentinel-1 antenna brackets after RUAG's case study (shape ours)
parts.what: The EOS's four lasers on the case study's two brackets, drawn see-through.

parts.caption: From day 161 the run's own bookings move the 3-D lab: trays to the openings, units to the docks (seed 1 of 16)
parts.what: Days 161-176 on seed 1 of 16: the Shuttles and units integrated; the replay drives the model.

parts.chapter: The two labs, like for like
parts.caption: Copper: 1.5-2.1x sooner in the automated lab with the funnel, 2x or more with BOFN or pKGFN. Aluminium's first: a tie
parts.what: Days to each target over 16 seeds an arm, the same policy and stock rule in both labs.

parts.caption: The same 45 tray positions: 3,029 sq ft in the vertical lab against 6,192 laid out flat for robots, 51 % less floor
parts.what: Three layouts side by side, then the Shuttles' 45 trays as bench positions.

parts.chapter: The whole lab at speed: a model year, week by week, then month by month
parts.caption: Two 30 ft Kardex Shuttle XP 500s, the floor machines, two UR12e arms on MiR250s and unit 3, the floor cleaner
parts.what: The counters run to the first year's totals, then the long-form's own 'first year' card.
